rejected_column_major_experiment.scope: Warm processing of decoded arrays, including column-major conversion for F runs. Five repeats per engine/workflow/layout; same final numerical sources. No input file read, JSON, HTTP or HTML.

limitations: One acquisition on one macOS arm64 host; agreement preserves implementation behavior and does not measure chemical identification accuracy. Review RSS increased in these runs. Rust still shares Python input reading, validation and report construction.
